CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: Shipped real if/then/else/fi conditionals for parenash (Phase 3b), a recursive-descent walk in the C host driver. Found and fixed a real bug: a trailing ';' in a condition silently discarded the real exit status, always taking the then-branch. 5 new real end-to-end tests, all pass; make test 347/347. (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)
